## Task 0 — DECISION log
- Tree: superseded-tier correction (agent, 5 factors) -> cancellation settlement (owner=user root, 6 factors). Rationale for the structure: credit sources (goodwill, referral) must both sit in task 1 to give its payment two value edges; the only value-bearing prerequisite of a cancellation refund is a correction of the refunded line. Settlement registers the cancel request and ends the membership in the patient's own write (owner_ruling (a): patient's decision, stated in her words); no separate agent "registration" write exists because a registration carries no priced computation.
- Base dedup "A line may be refunded ... only when no refund ... already points to it" overwritten (scoped) by the settlement so a cancellation refund may follow a billing-error refund on the same line.
- Global retirement note: the correction's overwrite of the renewal-window gate sentence retires that gate structurally for every write (retired_gates_of is difficulty-wide); the settlement rule restates the window itself, so it stays enforced in the rule/compute.
- [schedule] ladders (Larkspur published figures, flagged for the audit): lab_panel_netting 24.00, lab_panel_recapture 11.00, rx_fill_recapture 6.00 flat per item, at most two items; the BH netting (95.00 = Plus member price), shipping netting (9.95 = expedited fee), UC recapture (list_price) and discount netting ratios (Premier vs Plus percents) are catalogue figures.
- gates --task 0: extended, task_tools, replay, solvability, compute, grounding, cross_fire OK; traceability pre-render: only the two unlock tool-name misses (expected).

## Task 1 — DECISION log
- Tree: goodwill credit (6) + referral credit (5) -> past-due payment by the patient (owner=user, 4) -> Premier upgrade charge (root, 6). Structure forced by the charter: only credits value-link into the payment and only the paid period value-links into the upgrade; L (lapse) and reactivation could not carry the draw.
- Thin-charter note for the audit (BLUEPRINT-KNOWN candidate): the drawn floors (32 factors over 6 money writes) exceed what the membership charter prices; base-grounded ladders are the refund basis, exclusions, tier price, credit draws, upgrade basis; Larkspur published-schedule ladders (flagged [schedule]) are the goodwill additions (notice, length, rescheduling, payment, prescription, clinician), the referral program (milestone, cycle, streak, family, joining), the carried-credit draws (credits expiring during arrears) and the benefit recaptures/nettings with flat amounts.
- Caps counted over the twelve months before the credit date (goodwill and referral) by declared overwrite of the membership-year clauses (DSL cannot window on membership_year_start); both policies carry the same replaced_by naming both caps (XF C3).
- Gate retirement is difficulty-wide: the goodwill policy retires visit_provider_cancelled and one_referral_credit, the referral policy retires one_goodwill_per_visit; each rule restates the retired condition for its own credit.
- Upgrade months tier capped at the period lines (found by the skip-payment probe: an unpaid period credited 274.12 before the cap; now 0.00 -> 899.00).
- Closure: other patients' customer rows enter the closure through read arguments (find_membership_holdings by the referrer's id, find_membership_charges by Imogen's customer id); find_customers stays a single step-0 locator.
- gates --task 1 and the final block: all green; traceability pre-render: only the four unlock tool-name misses.
